text: Located in Sea Bright, this property sits inside the floodplain with a ground level about [[4 ft|measured]] below the base flood elevation of [[9 ft|measured]]. Over [[30 years|assumed]], the chance of flooding is about [[26%|modeled]] on current maps and rises to about [[35%|modeled]] with projected sea-level rise. Raising the lowest floor [[2 ft|assumed]] above the base flood elevation can reduce those [[30-year|assumed]] odds down to [[8%|modeled]].
